items.title: Pay garden maintenance invoice
items.quote: Wir bitten um Zahlung innerhalb von 14 Tagen nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung, Abzüge oder Skonto sind nicht vereinbart.
items.computation: The payment period is 14 days 'nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung' (from receipt of this invoice). This is a private company's invoice, not an authority letter, so no deemed-delivery rule applies and the period runs from the day the invoice actually arrived. The invoice carries no printed document date anywhere on the page, and no received date was given, so the start of the 14-day period cannot be fixed. Without a start date, the counting under §§ 187, 188 BGB and the weekend/holiday shift cannot be carried out, so no exact due date can be given.

warnings: The invoice has no printed date anywhere on the page, so the 14-day payment deadline ('Zahlung innerhalb von 14 Tagen nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung') cannot be computed exactly; use the date the invoice was actually received (postmark, email date, or hand-delivery date) to work out 14 days from then.

The IBAN printed (DE29 3705 0198 0005 5522 70) is a well-formed German IBAN matching the sender's own bank details on the letterhead, but ownership cannot be verified from the IBAN alone; confirm it matches earlier invoices from this company before paying.
